message.content: In the conversations provided, JenniferMoore suggests several types of stretches both before and after workouts. Before workouts, she recommends engaging in a warm-up that includes stretches. Specifically, she mentions drinking plenty of water and performing light activities like walking or gentle yoga to prepare the muscles. Post-workout, she advises spending some time stretching the muscles to improve flexibility and relieve tension. Additionally, she suggests using a foam roller on sore spots, which can help with muscle tightness. JenniferMoore also encourages listening to one's body and resting appropriately, ensuring not to overexert oneself. Overall, her approach emphasizes the importance of proper warm-up and cool-down routines to enhance flexibility and aid recovery.
